from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u048/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    frames = []
    for color in range(1, 10):
        cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == color]
        if not cells:
            continue
        r0 = min(r for r, c in cells); r1 = max(r for r, c in cells)
        c0 = min(c for r, c in cells); c1 = max(c for r, c in cells)
        if r1-r0 < 2 or c1-c0 < 2:
            continue
        if (all(grid[r0][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(grid[r1][c] == color for c in range(c0,c1+1)) and
            all(grid[r][c0] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1)) and
            all(grid[r][c1] == color for r in range(r0,r1+1))):
            pattern = [[grid[r][c] == color for c in range(c0+1,c1)]
                       for r in range(r0+1,r1)]
            frames.append((color,r0,r1,c0,c1,pattern))
    sources = [f for f in frames if any(any(row) for row in f[5])]
    if not sources:
        return out
    source = sources[0]
    pattern = source[5]
    ph, pw = len(pattern), len(pattern[0])
    for color,r0,r1,c0,c1,inner in frames:
        if color == source[0] and (r0,r1,c0,c1)==(source[1],source[2],source[3],source[4]):
            continue
        ih, iw = r1-r0-1, c1-c0-1
        if (ih,iw) == (ph,pw):
            for i in range(ih):
                for j in range(iw):
                    out[r0+1+i][c0+1+j] = color if pattern[i][j] else 0
        else:
            for r in range(r0,r1+1):
                for c in range(c0,c1+1):
                    out[r][c] = 0
    return out
'''
file=program_dir/'task-f7e42dae.py'
file.write_text(code)
print(file)
